en.title: Inspect a welcome slip
en.statement: This complete program reads one input line and prints Welcome, followed by one space and that line. Inspect the supplied input setup and predict the greeting before running. Do not replace the input with a fixed name.
hints: Separate the fixed greeting from the name received on the input line.
Keep name outside the quoted greeting, so its stored text becomes part of the output.
Print the fixed text Welcome, with a space after the comma, joined to name.

steps.label: Receive the slip
steps.prompt: Which supplied line receives the name? Explain its role without memorizing the input setup.

steps.label: Build the greeting
steps.prompt: Which characters stay fixed, and which come from the slip? Predict the output for Jo.
